title: Micro-skill Node (per-class in-depth graph)
description: One micro-skill inside a macro concept node. Lives in kg/classes/class-NN.json. Micro id = parent macro id + '.' + slug. Array order within a parent = recommended teaching order.

parent.description: Macro node id from kg/spine.json; must be the id minus its last segment.

description.description: 1-2 sentences: exactly what this micro-skill is.

outcomes.description: Observable can-do statements, finer-grained than the parent's.

prereqs.description: Micro ids (usually earlier micros of the same or sibling topics) and/or macro ids from other grades. The parent's own prerequisites need not be repeated.

misconception_refs.description: Ids (m1...) of the PARENT node's misconceptions that typically surface at this micro-skill.

question.description: Optional single diagnostic item for tricky micros; same engineering rules as macro questions.
